purpose: Generated resolved connection description; edit source declarations or compiled resources, then refresh.

coordinate_convention.heading: outward; 0 degrees north, clockwise in plan view
coordinate_convention.slope: outward rise/run at the edge; percent = 100 * grade

piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 — Diagonal Highway and Slip-Lane Stamp.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 — Straight Diagonal Highway Stamp
piece.description: Straight double-decker highway with slip lanes and barrier cutouts only. All curved ramp pavement, undersides, and barriers are separately placed attachments.

provenance.geometry: Retained measured highway sockets and separately attached R40 continuations.
provenance.construction: Disjoint sparse ownership; four proper rotations repeated; no reflected traffic.
provenance.partition_review: Corrected straight21-cell highway stamp; all four complete curved high throats belong to separate ramps. Retains puzzle, menu, preview, and reserved block identities. Uninstalled prototype local tile slots follow the reviewed new AutoTileBase grid.

connections.purpose: Intrinsic saved-resource endpoints, service roles, directed journeys, and forbidden transfers for one piece.

source.scope: one piece only; no counterpart catalogue is consulted
source.construction_basis: Actual emitted per-piece rule sections from the independently verified saved build
